Subject: Executive headcount runway & Q2 slate — approvals needed

Team — attaching the Q2 executive headcount request and comp-band reference. High-level ask below: 

- Roles: Head of Product Partnerships (E8), VP of Applied ML (E9), Head of EU Sales (E8)
- Timing: two planned starts in May (Product Partnerships, EU Sales), one backfilled for June (Applied ML)
- Compensation: proposed bands attached; hiring team is asking for market‑competitive offers at the top of band for Product Partnerships and Applied ML due to strategic urgency
- Budget/Runway: proposed hires fit within the Q2 commitment if we accept a one‑time *signing premium* for two roles (see sheet tab "BudgetImpact")

Ask: please review and reply with (A) approve / reduce / delay, and (B) any constraints on offer flexibility (signing bonus, relocation, equity uplift). I need consolidated signoff by 3/30 noon PT so recruiting can extend offers week of 4/5.

Attachments: Q2_executive_hc_request.xlsx (xlsx), comp_band_reference.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — Jonas

- For VP Applied ML (E9), recommend we reduce base target by 8% and fund the gap with a one‑time signing bonus instead of permanent uplift to base; delaying the hire to early Q3 would reduce P&L impact but risks losing the finalist.
